response.sql: WITH equipment_averages AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS average_humidity FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref HAVING AVG(humepct) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_humidity) AS reference_average FROM equipment_averages), kept AS (SELECT e.* FROM equipment_averages AS e CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.reference_average IS NOT NULL AND e.average_humidity > o.reference_average), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(average_humidity) AS reference_average FROM kept) SELECT k.equipref, k.average_humidity, k.average_humidity - o.reference_average AS excess_over_all_average, ABS(k.average_humidity - m.reference_average) AS distance_from_kept_mean FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN overall AS o CROSS JOIN kept_mean AS m WHERE m.reference_average IS NOT NULL ORDER BY distance_from_kept_mean DESC NULLS LAST, k.equipref LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: “How far” means absolute distance from the kept-equipment mean.

alternatives.interpretation: If the last difference should be signed, subtract the kept-equipment mean from each equipment average.
